ecommerce.title: E-commerce Platform
ecommerce.description: Development of a modern platform for online sales with user account, cart, and payment system integration
ecommerce.full_description: Full-featured e-commerce platform with modern design and excellent performance. Implemented: product catalog with filters and search, cart with persistence, user account, payment system integration, notification system, responsive design for all devices.
ecommerce.challenge: Create a fast and convenient sales platform with high conversion
ecommerce.solution: Used Vue 3 with Composition API for reactivity, Nuxt for SSR and SEO, Pinia for state management

crm.title: CRM Dashboard
crm.description: Customer data management interface with analytics visualization and routine task automation
crm.full_description: Comprehensive CRM system for customer data management. Includes dashboard with analytics, lead management system, task automation, email integration, reports and data export.
crm.challenge: Automate routine manager tasks and improve data visibility
crm.solution: React with TypeScript for type safety, Recharts for visualization, Tailwind for rapid styling

corporate.title: Corporate Website
corporate.description: Corporate website for IT company with animations, blog, and CMS integration
corporate.full_description: Modern corporate website with attractive design and smooth animations. Includes service pages, company portfolio, blog with CMS, contact forms, SEO optimization.
corporate.challenge: Create a memorable brand website that attracts clients
corporate.solution: Next.js for SSR and performance, GSAP for animations, Strapi as headless CMS

saas.title: SaaS Landing
saas.description: Landing page for SaaS product focused on conversion, A/B testing, and analytics
saas.full_description: High-conversion landing page for SaaS product. Optimized for lead capture, includes capture forms, demo version, client testimonials, FAQ, analytics integration.
saas.solution: Webflow for rapid development and easy editing, integration with Google Analytics and Hotjar

pwa.title: Mobile App Interface
pwa.description: PWA application for mobile devices with offline mode and push notifications
pwa.full_description: Progressive web application with native UX. Works offline, sends push notifications, has responsive interface optimized for mobile devices.
pwa.challenge: Create mobile app without separate iOS and Android development costs
pwa.solution: Vue 3 with PWA plugin, Firebase for backend and notifications, Vite for fast builds

analytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.description: Business metrics visualization system with real-time data updates and custom reports
analytics.full_description: Powerful analytics system with real-time data visualization. Supports custom dashboards, report export, metric-based alerts, integration with various data sources.
analytics.challenge: Visualize large volumes of data in real-time
analytics.solution: React with D3.js for complex visualizations, Node.js backend, WebSocket for real-time updates
